$comment: Necessary but not sufficient: decimal bounds (x-gie-*), canonical order, cross-field invariants (x-gie-invariants), lifecycle rules (x-gie-behaviour), exact 64-bit integer tokens and printable-text rules are enforced by the reference implementation gie.contracts.

RunModel.description: One model version a run is allowed to use, pinned for the whole run.

status.description: Its promotion status as pinned for this run.

valid_from_ns.description: First instant at which the run may use it; null = from the start.

valid_until_ns.description: End (exclusive) of its use; null = until the end of the run.

validated.description: ModelVersion.validated as pinned for this run (ACTIVE and not resting on fixture data).

x-gie-invariants.rule: valid_from_ns < valid_until_ns when both are given; only an ACTIVE model can be validated

description: Identity and reproducibility record of one run; the first record of its journal.

code_commit.description: Commit of the code that executes the run.

code_tree_dirty.description: True if the working tree had uncommitted changes: the commit then does not identify the code.

config_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the complete run configuration (canonical JSON).

contract_set_version.description: Version of the contract set in use.

created_time_ns.description: When a paper run was started (system clock).  Always null for a replay, whose identity and journal must not depend on when it was executed.

data_end_ns.description: End (exclusive) of the replayed period; null for a paper run.

data_origin.description: Least trustworthy origin of the market data the run uses; no record of the run may claim a better one.

data_sources.description: Tick sources (versioned feed ids) the run reads; ticks of any other source are refused.

data_start_ns.description: Start of the replayed period; null for a paper run.

mode.description: REPLAY or PAPER.  No live mode exists (routing lock).

models.description: Model versions the run may use, with the status pinned for the run and, optionally, the period in which each may be used (walk-forward schedule).
models.x-gie-canonical-order: sorted by start of validity, then id

producer.description: Component instance that emitted the record; together with the contract name it names the stream.

risk_regime.description: Whether the daily risk states of the account are enforced in this run.

run_id.description: identity.run_id(mode, hash of all other fields); see derive_run_id.

schema_version.description: Version of the contract the message was written with.

seed.description: Seed of the run; every pseudo-random element derives its own seed from it (gie.core.ids.derive_seed).  Null = the run uses no randomness.

seq.description: Position of the record in its stream: starts at 0 and increases by exactly 1.

shadow_of_run_id.description: Primary run a SHADOW run is compared with; null otherwise.

title: RunManifest 1.0.0

x-gie-invariants.rule: run_id equals identity.run_id(mode, SHA-256 of the canonical form of all other fields)
a REPLAY run states its data period (start < end) and no creation time; a PAPER run states its creation time and no data period
shadow_of_run_id is set if and only if role is SHADOW, and is not the run itself
the manifest is the first record of its stream (seq 0)
only a RESEARCH run may be UNCONSTRAINED_RESEARCH; a PRIMARY run uses owner-approved (ACTIVE) models only
